authorization.purpose: One exact staged-source local native source-compatibility attempt only; no audible quality, human evaluation, tajwid, full S2S, or deployment claim.

lifecycle_findings: Read complete probe.py, all three helper files, README gate schema and all 15 pure tests; inspected actual admission, Speech borrowed-lease, natural adapter, backend and duration cleanup integration.

Actual evaluation AdmissionCoordinator replaces the outer Speech bridge claim. Inner borrowed coordinators delegate evaluation production checks without another flock; canonical inode and nonblocking no-queue admission remain in use.
TTS rows are appended before asynchronous spawning, including failed spawn attempts; the fifth attempt is rejected. DP spawning is limited to one session and cannot retry.

The supervisor's 180-second deadline starts before production dependency preflight and all child construction; it reserves 15 seconds for termination/reaping/readback. The child receives the same deadline. Deadline overruns cannot pass final readback.

Cancellation joins owned tasks, closes the stream and preview resources, kills/waits owned native processes, and rejects a retained failed natural lease. Duration cleanup releases its borrowed lease only after terminal cleanup. The subreaper enumerates, terminates, kills and reaps owned descendants before final success; no second supervisor flock is taken.

Cleanup readiness is supported by actual waits, terminal process returncodes, retained-lease rejection and final descendant absence, not merely a claimed cleanupReady flag. These are statically reviewed controls, not an observed native cleanup result.

The clean child environment excludes provider credentials; private output directory is mode 0700, audio remains local, native stdout/stderr are bounded by existing adapters and native workers, and no browser, ASR model or API brain invocation is added.

Success requires exact full fixture source reconstruction, one terminal last flag, nonempty validated mono 16-bit 44100-Hz PCM WAVs, completed TTS attempts, unchanged production PID/selectors/dependency hashes, stage/source and persistent lock readback, descendant reaping, and successful final receipt publication.
limitations: No inference, ONNX session, readiness pass, gated probe or native process was run. Pure tests do not establish native compatibility or audible quality.
Production worker detection is polling-based and inherits the documented snapshot race; this is not an atomic production-preemption guarantee.

The 180-second success bound is enforced by deadlines and final elapsed checks; pathological kernel I/O or unkillable processes cannot be guaranteed to terminate within wall time and must not be reported passed.
Installed Python/runtime binaries are read-only external dependencies, not an exhaustive cryptographic inventory of the complete interpreter installation.
issues_encountered: One combined read exceeded the output window; complete omitted helper sections were subsequently read directly.
